hooks.prompt:
Before stopping, check if implementation work was done in this conversation that requires progress tracking updates. If code was implemented for a feature or task:

1. CHECK tasks.md: Were any tasks completed? If so, mark their checkboxes as done (- [ ] → - [x]) in the corresponding docs/epics/{epic}/features/{feature}/tasks.md file.

2. CHECK slicing.md: If ALL tasks of a feature are now complete, update the Features Summary table in docs/epics/{epic}/slicing.md to mark that feature as 'Done' (add a Status column if not present).

3. CHECK roadmap.md: If ALL features of an epic are now complete, update docs/product/roadmap.md to change the epic Status from 'Pending' to 'Done'.

If no implementation work was done (only research, discussion, or planning), return ok=true. If progress tracking documents need updating, return ok=false with reason explaining which documents need updating.
